evidence.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON l.product_id=p.product_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date))=2025) SELECT ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(tagged_revenue,2) AS tagged_revenue, ROUND(100*tagged_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS tagged_pct, ROUND(restated_revenue,2) AS restated_revenue, ROUND(100*restated_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS restated_pct, ROUND(tagged_failing_restated_amount,2) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM x
evidence.verification_note: Recurring revenue analysis confirmed. Note: this SQL uses a slightly different condition (TRIM check on service_period_start) vs E-007 but produces the same result. Both are verified.

evidence.sql: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), hist AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prior_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS had_positive_before FROM monthly ), classified AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, prior_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS new_logo_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > prior_arr THEN arr_usd - prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd < prior_arr THEN prior_arr - arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd = 0 THEN prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS reactivation_arr FROM hist ), agg AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(new_logo_arr),2) AS new_logo_arr, ROUND(SUM(expansion_arr),2) AS expansion_arr, ROUND(SUM(contraction_arr),2) AS contraction_arr, ROUND(SUM(churned_arr),2) AS churned_arr, ROUND(SUM(reactivation_arr),2) AS reactivation_arr FROM classified ), begin_end AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS beginning_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS ending_arr FROM monthly ) SELECT beginning_arr, new_logo_arr, expansion_arr, contraction_arr, churned_arr, reactivation_arr, ending_arr, ROUND(beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr,2) AS reconciled_ending_arr, ROUND(ending_arr - (beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr),2) AS reconciliation_diff FROM begin_end CROSS JOIN agg

evidence.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) AS group_customer_name, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS revenue_usd, MIN(CAST(c.first_order_date AS DATE)) AS first_order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(il.line_amount_usd) DESC, COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id)) AS rn FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer p ON c.parent_customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), COALESCE(p.customer_name, c.customer_name) ), top10 AS ( SELECT *, ROUND(months_between(DATE'2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 12.0, 2) AS tenure_years FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 10 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, ROUND(AVG(tenure_years),2) AS average_tenure_years FROM top10
